coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 7 of 11 ground-truth items (64%): all three prompting methods, all three tasks, and fixed random seeds.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies alternative A100-SXM4-80GB/H100 hardware rather than NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB. Does not require 10 repeated runs per task; five API repeats and ten warm-up runs are not equivalent. Omits the shared prompting-framework installation and BoT repository configuration requirement. Measures raw latency in seconds rather than base-10 logarithmic inference time per instance.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected inference-time comparison nor the task-specific logarithmic timing results.
